name: Job Smith

events.title: Deeds from his father
events.description: Richard Smith Sr. and wife Sarah gave Job 20 acres on the North Neck for life, remainder to Job's four sons Job, Richard, Joseph and Timothy, and 180 acres at Stony Brook Neck to grandsons Job and Richard; acknowledged 17 Sept 1688 before Wait Winthrop

bioAdditions: Pelletreau prints the 30 Aug 1688 deeds by which Richard 'Bull' Smith and his wife Sarah settled land on Job and on Job's sons Job, Richard, Joseph and Timothy (S2). These are near-primary proof of Job's parentage and of the eldest sons' order. The Appendix (pp. 478-479) gives the full list of Job's children: Job 2d (b. 9 Mar 1679), 'Saint' Richard, Timothy, Aaron, James, Joseph and Elizabeth (said to be the second wife of Rev. Daniel Taylor). His wife is Elizabeth, daughter of John Thompson of Setauket (S1). Pelletreau puts Job's death 'about 1719' in the Appendix and 'before 1720' in the Introduction (S1, S3). Weygant (1897) gives the same seven children (S4).

openQuestionsResolved.question: Exact birth/death dates; whether Elizabeth Thompson was mother of all his children.
openQuestionsResolved.answer: No exact dates found: d. about 1719 / before 1720 (Pelletreau). Eldest son Job 2d b. 9 Mar 1679. All seven children are attributed to Job & Elizabeth (Thompson) by Pelletreau and Weygant. No second wife is mentioned.

sources.citation: W. S. Pelletreau, Records of the Town of Smithtown (1898), Appendix pp. 478-479, 'Descendants of Job Smith, Son of the Patentee' and 'Descendants of James Smith, Son of Job, 1st' (full text read on archive.org)
